display_messages: display a list of ParlAI message dicts as a formatted string with optional verbose mode
nice_report: render an agent metrics report dict as a beautiful formatted string or pandas table
str_to_msg: convert a tab-separated formatted string into a ParlAI message dict
msg_to_str: convert a ParlAI message dict into a tab-separated formatted string
Timer: create a Timer object to track elapsed time with start, stop, resume, and reset methods
